summary: Phase 4 HRMS testing (Leave Email Alerts, Attendance Selfie, Payroll Auto-Run). Backend 7/7 pytest PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_hrms_phase4.py: (1) Employee POST /api/hr/leave/apply -> 200 + backend log line 'New Leave Application' observed within 30s (HR email sent). (2) Admin PUT /api/hr/leave/{id}/approve -> log shows 'approved' notification. (3) Second leave apply + PUT /api/hr/leave/{id}/reject with reason -> log shows 'reject' notification. (4) Selfie: GET /api/hr/attendance/my returned an owned attendance record (id=73dd3fc4...), POST /api/hr/attendance/{id}/selfie (jpeg multipart) -> 200 with selfie_url /api/uploads/attendance_selfies/..., GET on that URL -> 200 image with JPEG magic bytes. (5) Cross-user 404: POST selfie to random uuid attendance id -> 404. (6) GET /api/hr/payroll-auto-run -> {enabled:true, last_run_period:'2026-07', last_run_count:1}, POST enabled=false -> GET returns false, re-enabled true at end (VERIFIED true via curl at final). (7) Manual POST /api/hr/payroll/generate {month:8,year:2026} -> 200 with >=1 records. Frontend (Playwright, REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL): employee@airyatra.com login -> /employee, Attendance tab shows check-in-btn ABSENT (already checked out today) and selfie-link-2026-08-01 thumbnail visible (count=1). Admin@airyatra.com -> /hr -> Payroll group -> Attendance & Payroll: Attendance tab shows admin-selfie-<empId>-<date> thumbnail for Rahul Verma (count=1). Payroll tab: payroll-auto-run-card visible with ON badge + 'Last run: 2026-07 (1 employees, ₹0)'. toggle-auto-run-btn: click -> shows OFF + 'Enable' button + toast 'Payroll auto-run disabled'; click again -> shows ON + 'Disable' button + toast 'Payroll auto-run enabled' (confirmed by screenshot). Regression: employee Leave tab apply-leave-btn -> submit-leave-btn produced new PENDING row; Payslips tab -> download-payslip-btn downloaded AirYatra_Payslip_August_2026.pdf.
seed_data_creation: Applied 2 additional leave requests via employee@airyatra.com (2026-10-05 approved, 2026-10-08 rejected) as required to verify email log lines. Uploaded one JPEG selfie to attendance 73dd3fc4-... via API (overwrote existing selfie_url on the same 2026-08-01 record — same URL pattern). Added one more PENDING leave via UI regression (2026-11-05). Payroll auto-run left ENABLED (verified via curl after tests).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login response uses 'access_token' (NOT 'token'). GET /api/hr/attendance/my may include leave-only rows that lack an 'id' field — filter to records where rec.get('id') exists. Selfie upload endpoint requires the attendance record to be owned by current_user (returns 404 otherwise, tested with fake uuid). Auto-run settings persist via db.hr_settings type=payroll_auto_run. Scheduler last_run_period='2026-07' with 1 record already logged; do NOT modify. Backend log file path used for email verification: /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log (search for 'New Leave Application', 'approved', 'reject'). Frontend AttendancePayroll uses text button 'Payroll / पेरोल' (Hindi + English) — click via get_by_text substring match. Payroll auto-run card shows 'ON'/'OFF' badge and Enable/Disable button label alternating.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - no defects found. All Phase 4 features (leave email alerts via BackgroundTasks + Hostinger SMTP, attendance selfie upload/serve/authorization, payroll auto-run toggle + last-run status card, manual payroll generate regression) work end-to-end. Only cosmetic warning was the browser 'Refused to set unsafe header Accept-Encoding' console noise which is a benign axios/browser artifact, unrelated to functionality.
